{"metadata":{"description":"Observe-only hash-chained evidence receipts for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333357514","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit","slug":"030611/qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit","topics":["agent-infrastructure","ai-agents","audit","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","evidence"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Observe-only hash-chained evidence receipts for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Qiushi DSH Evidence Audit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Leave a locally checkable execution trail without storing prompts, tool arguments, tool results, o"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"r session IDs in plaintext.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> Community-maintained and not an official DeepSeek project. Related trust-layer plugins: Telemetry "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Redactor, Verification Receipt, and Context Provenance."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Qiushi DSH Evidence Audit is an observe-only DeepSeek Harness Profile Bundle. It listens to the offi"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"cial `tools/result` and `session/event` extension points and appends deterministic, hash-chained JSO"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"NL evidence receipts. It never registers a model-facing tool, changes a prompt, transforms a tool re"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"sult, or appends to a session."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install from npm"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Prerequisites are Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and a DSH installation built from the tested commit"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rerequisites are Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and a DSH installation built from the tested commit."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The config dump should contain a row with id `qiushi-evidence-audit` and name `qiushi-dsh-evidence-a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"udit`. Receipts then default to `$DSH_HOME/evidence-audit/evidence-receipts.jsonl`, or `~/.dsh/evide"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"nce-audit/evidence-receipts.jsonl` when `DSH_HOME` is unset. If running DSH from its source checkout"},{"id":"p11s4","text":", replace `dsh` with that checkout's documented `pnpm dsh` launcher."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"To remove the bundle:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it can and cannot establish"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- It can make edits to retained records, untouched-prefix removal, broken links, and partial final l"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ines detectable when the existing file is verified.
- It can show that this observer saw specific ev"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ent categories and hashes in a particular local sequence.
- It **cannot** prove that a command ran c"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"orrectly, that a result was truthful, who produced the file, or that a valid suffix was not deleted."},{"id":"p15s5","text":"
- Its hashes are **not** redaction, encryption, digital signatures, or an external trust anchor. Pr"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"otect the receipt file as sensitive pseudonymous data."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"This release has one deliberately narrow compatibility claim: it was implemented and tested against "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a` on 2026-08-13. That"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" checkout identifies its packages as `0.1.0-rc.5`, but that version was not available from npm durin"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"g verification. This is therefore a commit-pinned claim, not a promise for npm release `0.0.1-rc.1`,"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" future DSH commits, or a semver range."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The official installer reads `package.json#dsh.bundle.patch`. `dsh.plugin.json` is additional projec"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t metadata with a local schema; the pinned DSH commit does not read that file and this project does "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"not claim otherwise."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Receipt data"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The default file is `$DSH_HOME/evidence-audit/evidence-receipts.jsonl`, or `~/.dsh/evidence-audit/ev"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"idence-receipts.jsonl` when `DSH_HOME` is unset or blank. The plugin creates the default directory w"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ith owner-only mode `0700` and the file with owner-only mode `0600` where the operating system honor"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"s POSIX modes. It never defaults to the current working directory."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Every line contains `schemaVersion`, `sequence`, `collectedAt`, `previousRecordHash`, and `recordHas"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"h`. `recordHash` is SHA-256 over canonical JSON for every field except `recordHash` itself. The next"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" line commits to it through `previousRecordHash`; the first line uses `null`. Startup verifies the c"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"omplete existing file and refuses to append if a line, sequence, record hash, or previous-hash link "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"sting file and refuses to append if a line, sequence, record hash, or previous-hash link is invalid."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A `session-event` receipt stores the hashed session ID, event type, event sequence and time, a hash "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"of event data, and the optional `ignorable` marker. A `tool-result` receipt stores the tool name, ha"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"shed call/root-call/session IDs, argument hash, final outcome hash, error flag, parent-presence flag"},{"id":"p22s4","text":", and optional error code."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **`eventDataHash`, `argumentsHash`, and `outcomeHash` are not redaction, encryption, "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"or digital signatures.** The JSONL excludes the observed plaintext, but an attacker who can guess a "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"low-entropy value can hash candidates and confirm a match offline. Treat the receipt file as sensiti"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ve pseudonymous data and protect it accordingly."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Event types and tool names remain readable because they are the stable audit categories. The two fee"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ds are not deduplicated: DSH may publish one logical tool outcome first on `tools/result` and then d"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"urably as a `tool/result` `session/event`. In that case this plugin intentionally writes two receipt"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"s describing two observations. Do not sum those receipts as independent tool executions."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Canonical JSON boundary"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`hashObservedValue` accepts only lossless JSON values: `null`, booleans, finite numbers, strings, de"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nse arrays, and plain objects with string keys. Object keys are sorted recursively using JavaScript'"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s default UTF-16 code-unit order. Strings use `JSON.stringify` escaping, SHA-256 consumes the result"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ing UTF-8 bytes, and Unicode normalization is not performed; canonically equivalent NFC and NFD stri"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ngs therefore hash differently."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Observe-only behavior"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations and remaining risks"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Hashes do not prove author identity and provide neither a digital signature nor a checkpoint ancho"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"red outside the host.
- A completed `writeSync` is not an `fsync` durability guarantee. A power loss"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" or kernel/storage failure can lose the last receipt.
- Multiple DSH processes must not write the sa"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"me file concurrently. Detection occurs only on a later verification and is not recovery; use one out"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"put file per process/profile.
- Startup verification is linear in the existing file size, and synchr"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"onous append I/O adds latency to the event publisher.
- POSIX modes do not express full Windows ACL "},{"id":"p31s7","text":"policy. Verify ACLs for sensitive deployments.
- The plugin observes live publications after it moun"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ts. Constructor seed/replay events that DSH deliberately does not publish on `session/event` are not"},{"id":"p31s9","text":" backfilled.
- The compatibility smoke did not perform a model-backed DSH turn: the pinned shallow c"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"heckout had no installed/built workspace dependencies or API credential. It did exercise the real Co"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"rdis runtime and the official bundle patch parser/application semantics."}],"truncated":true}
